summary: Northumbria University's UKRI AI Centre for Doctoral Training in Citizen-Centred Artificial Intelligence, in Newcastle upon Tyne, opened applications for its September 2027 PhD intake on 12 October 2026. Applications close on 11 January 2027 at 17:00 GMT. Eligible full-time home-fee students receive an enhanced annual stipend of GBP 30,000; international and part-time applicants may apply at standard UKRI rates.
highlights: Feedback on a draft proposal can be requested until 11 December 2026.
Enhanced GBP 30,000 annual stipend for eligible full-time home-fee students.
International and part-time applicants may apply at standard UKRI rates.
Application status not yet confirmed: verify the dates and requirements on the official Northumbria page before applying.
